meta.file: CODED Juniors camp-deck style: ~230 Juniors 2026 Google Slides decks (colours sampled from renders), the KFH Baiti weekend decks and the CODED Juniors Slide Template. JR-25 Brand Guide kept for print and merch.

tokens.name: juniors-red
tokens.usage: THE CODED Juniors red, sampled from the camp decks. Full-bleed hero slides (covers, titles, dividers, Activity/Challenge Time, statement slides, Thanks) and the red half of split slides. White text on it is 3.6:1: bold display sizes (44px+) only, as in every deck.

tokens.name: juniors-red-deep
tokens.usage: Deep red: date-tile boxes on the program cover, pressed states. White text on it 5.5:1.

tokens.name: juniors-red-tint
tokens.usage: Red tint: the background of the "Ask your mentor if you're good to go!" pill (red text on it, 3.1:1 at 36px bold). Never a slide background.

tokens.name: keyword-blue
tokens.usage: Keyword blue: the 2nd keyword colour in a sentence, number dot 2, 2D answers. On content-white 4.5:1. Also the School/KNET blue skin.

tokens.name: keyword-amber
tokens.usage: Keyword amber: the 3rd keyword colour, number dot 3, "Think about…" pills. Only 2.4:1 on content-white: the decks' own pairing, kept for bold display words (44px+) only; never body text.

tokens.name: keyword-purple
tokens.usage: Keyword purple: an occasional 4th keyword ("Enjoy"), the [COLOR] blank in prompt templates. 5.3:1 on content-white.

tokens.name: success-green
tokens.usage: Green: "Strong" pills, Recap Stars answers, YES. White text on it 3.3:1, bold 42px+ only. Always with a word, never colour alone.

tokens.name: yellow-on-red
tokens.usage: Soft yellow: the subtitle, the key word and "Step N" on red hero slides. About 2.5:1 on juniors-red: the decks' signature pairing, kept exact for display sizes (60px+) only.

tokens.name: lavender-on-red
tokens.usage: Lavender: the first word of a divider on red ("Activity", "Challenge", "BREAK"), then "Time!" in white. About 2.6:1 on juniors-red, display sizes only.

tokens.name: content-white
tokens.usage: Content slide background (the soft grey-white of the decks). The only light slide background.

tokens.name: card-white
tokens.usage: Cards, tiles, white pills on red, logo and text on red.

tokens.name: placeholder-grey
tokens.usage: Empty picture boxes inside cards in templates (replace with a real picture before class).

tokens.name: hairline
tokens.usage: The bottom rule on content slides, recap arrows.

tokens.name: dashed-frame
tokens.usage: 4px dashed border of placeholder frames in templates.

tokens.name: ink
tokens.usage: Headings and body on content-white and card-white (16.1:1).

tokens.name: ink-soft
tokens.usage: Second line under a heading on content slides (7:1).

tokens.name: ink-muted
tokens.usage: Sub-lines, card descriptions, "You Are a" lead-in on content-white (5.7:1).

tokens.name: ink-faint
tokens.usage: Placeholder labels and the grey "Weak" pill. 3.0:1: 32px+ only.

tokens.name: screen-frame
tokens.usage: Dark frame around tool screenshots and video.

tokens.name: rule-on-red
tokens.usage: The bottom rule on red slides.

tokens.name: glow-on-red
tokens.usage: Centre of the soft radial glow behind Codey on covers and Game Time.

tokens.name: girls-pink
tokens.usage: Girls Camp skin: pink covers.

tokens.name: girls-coral
tokens.usage: Girls Camp skin: content dividers and panels (instead of juniors-red).

tokens.name: winter-blue
tokens.usage: Winter Camp / SACGC Winter skin: blue gradient start (to #1E7BF0), snow island title.

tokens.name: partner-green
tokens.usage: KFH partner skin: the green program cover gradient (#2A8A1C → #43B02A → #6CC447) used for KFH Baiti. Partner covers only.

tokens.name: boubyan-teal
tokens.usage: Boubyan Al-Ghaly white-label skin (no CODED or Juniors wording on those decks).

tokens.name: brandguide-red
tokens.usage: JR-25 Brand Guide red (Pantone 485 C): print, merch and the logo artwork. Slides use juniors-red.

tokens.name: brandguide-navy
tokens.usage: JR-25 Brand Guide navy: staff uniforms, staff decks, print typography.

tokens.name: brandguide-blue
tokens.usage: JR-25 Brand Guide blue (Pantone 2728 C): print announcements and the CODED JUNIORS tape sticker.

tokens.name: brandguide-yellow
tokens.usage: JR-25 Brand Guide yellow (Pantone 123 C): print accents.

tokens.name: surface-hero
tokens.usage: Hero slides and the red half of split slides. A deck uses two backgrounds only: this and surface-content.

tokens.name: surface-content
tokens.usage: Content slides.

tokens.name: surface-card
tokens.usage: Cards and tiles on surface-content.

tokens.name: text-heading
tokens.usage: Headings on surface-content and surface-card.

tokens.name: text-on-hero
tokens.usage: Headings on surface-hero (display sizes).

tokens.name: text-accent-on-hero
tokens.usage: Subtitles and key words on surface-hero (display sizes).

tokens.name: keyword-1
tokens.usage: 1st coloured keyword in a sentence on light slides (3.4:1 on content-white: bold 44px+ only).

tokens.name: keyword-2
tokens.usage: 2nd coloured keyword.

tokens.name: keyword-3
tokens.usage: 3rd coloured keyword (display sizes only).

tokens.name: keyword-4
tokens.usage: Occasional 4th keyword.

styles.name: slide-how
styles.usage: The one-word suspense slide ("How?!"), white on juniors-red.

styles.name: slide-hero
styles.usage: Left-column hero titles on red: activity title, Ice Breaker!, Challenge Time!, program name (140px).

styles.name: slide-statement
styles.usage: Questions and split-panel titles ("What do you think AI means?", "What is 3D?", "Google Gemini!"). 110–130px.

styles.name: slide-definition
styles.usage: The definition sentence on split slides and the "Today you will…" goal, with 2–3 coloured keywords. 80–86px.
styles.sample: Objects that have Length, Width, and Depth

styles.name: slide-heading
styles.usage: Content slide heading, top-left at y=150 (y=226 under an eyebrow pill), one coloured keyword.

styles.name: slide-subtitle
styles.usage: Yellow line under a hero title ("Day 1: Design Day", "Have Fun Coding!"). 56–64px.

styles.name: slide-list
styles.usage: Recap and reflection lines next to a 3D icon ("What is AI?"). 52–56px.

styles.name: slide-body
styles.usage: Step lines, card text, the sub-line under a definition (52px, ink-muted, weight 600). 44–52px.
styles.sample: Paste the prompt in the box

styles.name: slide-card
styles.usage: Card captions, rule reasons, picture labels. 36–40px.
styles.sample: Never touch the nozzle or plate

styles.name: slide-pill
styles.usage: Eyebrow pills ("ROUND 1", "RECAP", "STEP 1" at 30px), white pills on red, the mentor-gate pill (36px italic).

styles.name: slide-min
styles.usage: The smallest text allowed on a kid slide. Nothing smaller (date-tile labels at 24px are the one exception).
styles.sample: Copy the prompt from Google Classroom.

styles.name: doc-title
styles.usage: Lesson plans, parent letters, web page titles.

styles.name: doc-heading
styles.usage: Section headings, with one red keyword.

styles.name: doc-body
styles.usage: Body copy in documents and on the web.
styles.sample: Kids learn coding, AI and robotics in the most fun way possible.

styles.name: arabic-display
styles.usage: Arabic display text (Senan decks, Kuwaiti-dialect ice breakers like "منو هالشخصيه؟", the salaam greeting). Kid slides are English; Arabic is cultural and decorative.

styles.name: arabic-body
styles.usage: Arabic body in parent messages and posts.

styles.name: brand-display
styles.usage: CODED_TYPE (Neufile Grotesk), the JR-25 Brand Guide face: merch, hoodies, printed signs. Not used on lesson slides.

tokens.name: slide-margin
tokens.usage: Left and right content margin on every 1920×1080 slide.

tokens.name: slide-heading-top
tokens.usage: Top of the heading (or of the eyebrow pill) on content slides.

tokens.name: slide-heading-under-pill
tokens.usage: Top of the heading when an eyebrow pill sits above it.

tokens.name: slide-rule-bottom
tokens.usage: The 2px bottom rule sits 70px from the bottom, from 120px to 120px.

tokens.name: logo-inset-x
tokens.usage: Logo distance from the left or right edge.

tokens.name: logo-inset-y
tokens.usage: Partner lockup distance from the top (44px for the 80px-tall solo logo).

tokens.name: split-panel
tokens.usage: Width of the coloured half of a split slide (left 0 or left 1075px). Text starts at 965px beside a left panel.

tokens.name: space-card-gap
tokens.usage: Gap between cards in a row (56–80px for 2–3 big cards).

tokens.name: space-card-pad
tokens.usage: Card padding (40px for badge cards, 64px for 3-card definitions).

tokens.name: space-stack
tokens.usage: Gap between heading and sub-line in a text column (32–56px).

tokens.name: space-pill-x
tokens.usage: Horizontal padding inside eyebrow pills (10px vertical).

tokens.name: radius-tile
tokens.usage: Pictures inside style tiles.

tokens.name: radius-image
tokens.usage: Pictures inside cards.

tokens.name: radius-frame
tokens.usage: Dark screenshot frames.

tokens.name: radius-card
tokens.usage: Cards and tiles.

tokens.name: radius-card-lg
tokens.usage: Big game-round cards and the prompt box.

tokens.name: radius-hero-image
tokens.usage: Big hero pictures (ice breaker, today's product).

tokens.name: radius-pill
tokens.usage: Pills, number dots, answer chips.

tokens.name: shadow-card
tokens.usage: Every card, tile and hero picture.

tokens.name: shadow-tile-on-red
tokens.usage: White date tiles and stickers on red.

tokens.name: shadow-pill-on-red
tokens.usage: The big white website pill on Game Time.

tokens.name: border-rule
tokens.usage: Bottom rule on every slide.

tokens.name: border-dashed
tokens.usage: Dashed placeholder frames and the red dashed prompt box.

tilt.note: Stickers, stars, date tiles and some pictures tilt. Text never tilts.

tokens.name: tilt-tile
tokens.usage: Date tiles on the cover (-2° and +2°).

tokens.name: tilt-sticker
tokens.usage: Arabic stickers on Thanks (between -8° and +6°).

tokens.name: tilt-star
tokens.usage: 3D stars and the Super Coder badge (±10–12°); the pink question mark +8°.
